approve_effect: Starts only the formal CR and its CP0/CP1 preparation. CP2 remains the required human decision for route, verifier and read scope; no approval grants credentials, provider access, lake writes, real computation or trading.

cp1_review_profile.reason: product baseline docs or product_baseline_refresh_required indicate use-case completeness must be rechecked

goal_statement: Decide the bounded Stage 3 real-lake entry route, its deny-default research-read boundary, historical-evidence status, verifier path and candidate readiness inventory; do not implement, compute, repair, publish or trade.
not_authorized_by_approve: credential, secret, account or environment read
provider fetch, NAS/lake write, catalog/current-pointer mutation, publish or deployment
C1-C4 real computation, producer binding, aggregate orchestration or CR155 promotion
QMT, broker, simulation, paper, live or trading activity
repair, backfill, manifest rewrite, strategy rerun or historical-evidence remediation
reject_effect: Stage 3 remains unstarted and no real-lake read may proceed under this candidate.
scope_summary: 将 CR-161 的 `FU-CR161-010` 候选项正式化为 Stage 3 的决策、授权边界与历史事实收敛门。CR-171 决定：采用 current runner 还是 C1-C4 real-producer 路线、是否采用事件锚定的 FU-006 verifier waiver、以及可在后续受控读取中使用的冻结 release 候选范围。它不实施 producer、aggregate、修复、真实计算或运行时行为。
split_rationale: The decision concerns real-data authorization, architecture route and Stage 3 claim integrity. It has a distinct approver, risk class, audit boundary and rollback from CR-161 follow-up tracking.
title: Stage 3 Launch / Real-Lake Entry Decision Gate
user_goal_impact: Provides the next auditable decision gate required before any Stage 3 real-data-lake work can be considered; it does not itself start Stage 3.
why_not_merge_with_parent: CR-161 is closed; FU-CR161-010 was explicitly tracked as a candidate requiring a separate formal CR and CP0 precheck.
why_not_story_or_task: No implementation is authorized. This CR first establishes product scope, runtime authorization and architecture decisions that later CRs/Stories must consume.
